about_the_game:
"Daddy... I'm scared. I don't like the robots..."

"It's ok, Annah... I'm here. I'll always be here for you."

Welcome to the start of the Nightmare.

In the prologue to the events of Chapter 1, you play as a young Annah- daughter of Tim Spencer. Your dad always said he'd be there to protect you but this time... he's not. A monster represented as RadioWave is taking over your mind... can you survive the RadioWave?

What's included in this DLC pack?

This DLC for RadioWave includes content for a new Chapter plus exclusive Custom Mode content! No Multiplayer Mode content.

New Prequel Chapter 0: Black Signal

  • New Perspective: Gone are the days of being Detective Robbie: you're Annah Spencer: daughter of the famous Tim Spencer, AKA the founder of RadioWorld.

  • Hug your Plushy RadioWave: he'll let you know when the robot is near.

  • Discover the lore: Lots of lore to discover in this particular chapter, so get ready!

Custom Mode: 2 Maps and a Nightmare:

  • 2 new maps exclusive to the DLC: Home and Forest!

  • New Robot: RadioMare.

content_descriptors.notes: The robots in this game are violent and harm the player in various different ways which can be seem as violent. There is also depictions and implications of killings and violence.

short_description: This isn't the RadioWave you remember... discover the lore and even more origins behind the story of RadioWave in this thrilling prequel chapter and find out how Tim Spencer started his rampage.
